conventions:
LABELLING CONVENTIONS (applied strictly to every document)
- doctype: invoice (incl. credit notes), receipt (till receipt, payment confirmation, paid receipt/Quittung), bank_statement (account statement, bank export), contract (agreement, Vertrag, NDA, lease), letter (formal correspondence that is none of the others), quote (offer/Angebot/quotation/proforma), reminder (payment reminder, dunning, Mahnung, final notice), payslip, tax_document (tax assessment, tax return, VAT return, Steuerbescheid), other (everything else, incl. notes, meeting minutes, order confirmations, delivery notes, newsletters, ledgers, recipes, code, identity documents).
- doc_date: the date the document was issued/written, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". Statements: the statement date, else the period end. Contracts: the date printed as the date of the agreement (signature/"dated") else the effective date. Payslip: "YYYY-MM" (the pay period month) unless an exact issue date is printed. Letters: the letter date. Receipts: the purchase date. Never a due date, delivery/service date, validity date, birth date, or ID expiry. null when the document has no issue date. For e-mails see below.
- amount: a float with a dot decimal, the amount that identifies the document's value: invoice = the gross total of the invoice (negative for credit notes); receipt = the total paid; quote = the gross total offered; reminder = the total the sender demands now (a "total claim / Gesamtforderung / total due" line including fees if present, else the open invoice amount); payslip = the net payout (Auszahlungsbetrag / net pay); tax_document = the amount to pay or refund if one is printed (positive number), else null; contract = null unless one single contract value is explicitly labelled; letter, bank_statement, other = null. Keep the sign as printed.
- currency: ISO code (EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, JPY, SEK) of that amount, null when amount is null.
- counterparty: the issuing/sending party exactly as printed in the letterhead / sender block / From display name (keep the legal-form suffix: "Beispiel Handels GmbH"); for a person sender, the person's name; null if no sender is identifiable (e.g. a bare till slip with no shop name, or a note).
- reference: the document's own number as printed (invoice no., order/reference no., contract no., quote no.); null if none. ALWAYS null for payslip, tax_document, identity-like documents and other. Never an IBAN, a card number, a tax ID, a personal ID.
- lang: "en" or "de" (the main language).
- Expected for e-mails: doc_date = the date of the Date header (ISO), counterparty = the From display name (without the address), doctype by what the mail IS (an invoice mail whose body carries the invoice data is an invoice; a payment-reminder mail is a reminder; a newsletter/chat/meeting mail is other), amount/reference from the body when present.

ANNOTATION DECISIONS (round 2: additions and points the convention text leaves open; evaluators should be aware of them)
1. Reference means the document's OWN printed number only. A reminder or letter that merely cites an invoice or contract number of another document gets reference null unless it prints its own number (Mahnung Nr., Reminder no., Unser Zeichen, Our ref, Aktenzeichen). Round-2 examples: the final notice for two invoices (collections/final_notice_2026-03.pdf) and the two-invoice reminder mail (Mail/AR/Reminder 2 invoices overdue.eml) have reference null; the cancellation letter that cites 'Ihre Vertragsnummer 2210-77' has reference null.
2. If a receipt or online-order receipt prints only an order number or booking reference (no separate receipt number), that is its reference.
3. bank_statement: reference only for an explicitly labelled statement number (Auszugsnummer 01/2026 -> "01/2026"), else null. doc_date = statement date, else period end. Three statements print a period but no statement date (the Quarzbank PDF, the Foo Credit CSV, the Kontoumsaetze XLSX); their label is the period end. A statement export without a bank name (the XLSX) has counterparty null.
4. Identity-like document (identity card scan): doctype other and EVERY other field null, including lang (null). Exactly one document has lang null.
5. Order confirmations and delivery notes are doctype other even when they print prices and totals: amount null, reference null, doc_date and counterparty kept.
6. Contracts: amount only where one single contract value is explicitly labelled (the Austrian Werkvertrag: 'Gesamtwert des Vertrags: EUR 24.000,00'). Monthly rent, an annual salary, hourly rates and 'fees as agreed' stay null. A contract without letterhead (the .txt cooperation agreement) uses the first-named party as counterparty.
7. Invoice amount = the gross total of the invoice after discount lines (Rabatt, discount) and including shipping/freight, but BEFORE deposits (Anzahlung), payments received, or an offered early-payment discount (Skonto). A final invoice with 'abzgl. Anzahlung' is labelled with the full gross total, not the remaining balance.
8. Amounts in another currency that are marked as information (approx., equivalent, indicative, entspricht ca., Gegenwert) are never the label. The label is the currency of the document's own total line (e.g. GBP total with EUR information; SEK receipt with EUR information; USD reminder with EUR information).
9. Receipt amount = the total paid printed on the receipt, including tip and after vouchers or discount codes (restaurant 69.40 EUR; online order 95.15 EUR). A paid receipt (Quittung) for a deposit is labelled with the deposit paid. A remittance advice sent by the payer is treated as a payment confirmation (receipt); its counterparty is the payer who issued it and its amount is the total remitted.
10. A restaurant slip headed RECHNUNG that says paid by card is a receipt (paid receipt). A pro forma invoice is a quote. A Kostenvoranschlag / cost estimate is a quote with the gross estimate as amount; a quote with a quantity discount is labelled with the gross total after discount (Swiss offer rounded to 5 Rappen as printed).
11. Reminder amount = the total demanded now (Gesamtforderung, Total zu zahlen, Total now due, Total overdue, Gesamtbetrag) including fees and interest; for reminders listing two invoices it is the combined claim.
12. A cancellation notice (Kündigung) and a reservation confirmation are letters, not contracts. Letters from private persons start with the recipient block, then the sender block; the counterparty is the person named in the sender block.
13. Tax documents: self-prepared returns/computations (UK VAT return, personal income tax calculation, corporate tax computation) have the taxpayer printed in the heading as counterparty; authority-issued documents (municipal tax invoice, notice of assessment) have the authority. amount = balance payable or expected refund, as a positive number.
14. Payslip doc_date is "YYYY-MM"; the one payslip that prints "Issued: 27 February 2026" is labelled with that full ISO date. Equivalents in another currency (EUR) are not labels.
15. Counterparty keeps the printed capitalisation (NORDLICHT MUSTER GMBH vs Maple Test Corp.).
16. E-mail doc_date is the calendar date of the Date header in the header's own UTC offset; no mail is timed near midnight. Several mails carry HTML-ish leftovers (tags,   entities, quoted-printable escapes such as =C3=BC) exactly as an extractor that does not strip them would deliver; the counterparty is still the From display name.
17. Swiss and Austrian conventions are used in several documents: d.m.yyyy dates, 'Jänner', 'Fr. 18.50' and CHF with apostrophe thousands separators, a euro sign before the amount, UID numbers, MWST. Slash dates are only used where unambiguous (14/02/2026).
18. Mixed-language documents are labelled with the main language of the body: the Italian/English invoice, the DE/EN cooperation agreement, the EN/DE shipping notice and the letter with English body and German salutation are 'en'; the mixed reminder mail with German body is 'de'.
19. OCR-style noise (swapped l/1 and O/0, missing umlauts, joined or split words, broken letters) appears in 22 documents (all 14 image scans and 8 PDFs, verified by searching the text for the inserted tokens); it never touches the tokens of counterparty, reference, amount or date, and labels are the clean printed values.
20. Documents with exactly one date-like string: the fuel receipt (03-Apr-2026) and the letter dated 31 July 2026. Dates earlier or later than the document date (invoice, delivery, due, validity, contract end, event, ID expiry) are distractors and never the label.
